faq_heading: Homes near Panorama Park Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Panorama Park Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Panorama Park Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Panorama Park Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Panorama Park Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 74 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,235,000, townhomes $750,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Panorama Park Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Panorama Park Elementary the median was 23 days on the market, closing at 96.4% of the list price, with 12% of sales above the list price for the 74 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Panorama Park Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are J T Brown Elementary (0.8 km south-west), Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (0.9 km north-east) and St Bernadette (0.9 km north-east).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Panorama Park Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Panorama Park Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Panorama Park Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Panorama Park Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 74 homes sold within 1 km of Panorama Park Elementary: 44 houses and 29 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,235,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Panorama Park Elementary

25 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Panorama Park Elementary in a straight line (19 elementary, 5 secondary, 1 other; 5 independent). The closest is J T Brown Elementary, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Seaquam Secondary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is St Bernadette (0.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (0.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: J T Brown Elementary (0.8 km south-west), St Bernadette (0.9 km north-east), Martha Jane Norris Elementary (0.9 km north), Boundary Park Elementary (1.1 km west), North Ridge Elementary (1.2 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is J T Brown Elementary, 0.8 km south-west of Panorama Park Elementary.
